subject: reasoning
question: Sarita says, "The girl standing near the tree is the daughter of the husband of my mother's sister." How is the girl related to Sarita?
solution:
• 
 
**“My mother’s sister”** → Sarita’s **aunt**.

 
 
• 
 
**“The husband of my mother’s sister”** → Sarita’s **uncle by marriage** (her aunt’s husband).

 
 
• 
 
**“The daughter of the husband of my mother’s sister”** →

 
 
• 
 
The daughter of her uncle (by marriage).

 
 
• 
 
That is **Sarita’s cousin**.
